title: The research tree
summary: Four branches. Each project shows what it needs: an earlier project, a building, a specialist or a find.
text:
The tree has four branches, each a tab: **Economy**, **Defence**, **People** and **Precursor**. Projects sit under the ones they follow, with what they do in green.

A project can wait on more than one thing, and the tree ticks each:

- an **earlier project** finished
- a **building** standing (Refined Drills needs a Mining Depot)
- a **specialist** living in the colony (Fire Control needs a Security officer)
- a **discovery** out in the world: a wreck, a carved stone, a relic grid, a nest destroyed, a camp met

So exploring, growing the right people and building widely all open the tree up. Some projects wait on the story itself: **Orbital Launch**, the way off this world, can't start until Act 1 is over.
